41:   /** Specifies that only complete partitions should be considered. */
42:   ONLY_COMPLETE(false),
43:   /** Specifies that complete as well as incomplete partitions should be considered. */
44:   INCOMPLETE_OK(true);
45: 
46:   private final boolean incompleteOk;
47: 
48:   Partitions(boolean incompleteOk)
49:   {
50:     this.incompleteOk = incompleteOk;
51:   }
52: 
53:   /**
54:    * Looks up timeline objects covering {@code interval}. Complete-only vs incomplete partitions are selected
55:    * according to this enum value.
56:    */
57:   <VersionType, ObjectType extends Overshadowable<ObjectType>> List<TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType>> lookup(
58:       VersionedIntervalTimeline<VersionType, ObjectType> versionedTimeline,
59:       Interval interval,
60:       boolean skipObjectsWithNoData
61:   )
62:   {
63:     List<TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType>> retVal = new ArrayList<>();
64:     final NavigableMap<Interval, VersionedIntervalTimeline<VersionType, ObjectType>.TimelineEntry> timeline;
65:     if (incompleteOk) {
66:       timeline = versionedTimeline.getIncompletePartitionsTimeline();
67:     } else {
68:       timeline = versionedTimeline.getCompletePartitionsTimeline();
69:     }
70: 
71:     for (Entry<Interval, VersionedIntervalTimeline<VersionType, ObjectType>.TimelineEntry> entry : timeline.entrySet()) {
72:       Interval timelineInterval = entry.getKey();
73:       VersionedIntervalTimeline<VersionType, ObjectType>.TimelineEntry val = entry.getValue();
74:       PartitionHolder<ObjectType> partitionHolder = val.getPartitionHolder();
75:       boolean holderHasData = false;
76:       for (PartitionChunk<ObjectType> chunk : partitionHolder) {
77:         if (chunk.getObject().hasData()) {
78:           holderHasData = true;
79:           break;
80:         }
81:       }
82: 
83:       // exclude empty partition holders (i.e. tombstones) since they do not add value
84:       // for higher level code...they have no data rows...
85:       if ((!skipObjectsWithNoData || holderHasData) && timelineInterval.overlaps(interval)) {
86:         retVal.add(
87:             new TimelineObjectHolder<>(
88:                 timelineInterval,
89:                 val.getTrueInterval(),
90:                 val.getVersion(),
91:                 PartitionHolder.copyWithOnlyVisibleChunks(partitionHolder)
92:             )
93:         );
94:       }
95:     }
96: 
97:     if (retVal.isEmpty()) {
98:       return retVal;
99:     }

101:     TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType> firstEntry = retVal.get(0);
102:     Interval firstInterval = firstEntry.getInterval();
103:     if (interval.overlaps(firstInterval) && interval.getStart().isAfter(firstInterval.getStart())) {
104:       DateTime trimmedStart = JodaUtils.maxDateTime(
105:           JodaUtils.maxDateTime(interval.getStart(), firstInterval.getStart()),
106:           DateTimes.MIN
107:       );
108:       retVal.set(
109:           0,
110:           new TimelineObjectHolder<>(
111:               new Interval(trimmedStart, firstInterval.getEnd()),
112:               firstEntry.getTrueInterval(),
113:               firstEntry.getVersion(),
114:               firstEntry.getObject()
115:           )
116:       );
117:     }
118: 
119:     TimelineObjectHolder<VersionType, ObjectType> lastEntry = retVal.get(retVal.size() - 1);
120:     Interval lastInterval = lastEntry.getInterval();
121:     if (interval.overlaps(lastInterval) && interval.getEnd().isBefore(lastInterval.getEnd())) {
122:       DateTime trimmedEnd = JodaUtils.minDateTime(interval.getEnd(), lastInterval.getEnd());
123:       retVal.set(
124:           retVal.size() - 1,
125:           new TimelineObjectHolder<>(
126:               new Interval(lastInterval.getStart(), trimmedEnd),
127:               lastEntry.getTrueInterval(),
128:               lastEntry.getVersion(),
